title: Gnani Recognizer Options
description: Gnani (Vachana) realtime STT options. Only applies when recognizer vendor is 'gnani'. Gnani produces final transcripts only, one per detected utterance. The model is set with the recognizer 'model' (prisma-v2.5 or prisma-v3.0); the recognizer language is mapped to an Indic code (e.g. en-US becomes en-IN), and 'any' or 'auto' turns on Indic auto-detection.

itnNativeNumerals.description: Write numbers in the native script numerals of the language.

replacement.description: Text written in place of any matched pattern.

biasList.description: Words to boost (prisma-v2.5). Defaults to single words from the recognizer's 'hints' on prisma-v2.5.

biasScore.description: Boost strength for biasList. Defaults to 1 when biasList comes from hints.

keyterms.description: Key terms to boost (prisma-v3.0). Defaults to the recognizer's 'hints' on prisma-v3.0.

topic.description: Free-text description of the conversation topic.

previousText.description: Preceding conversation text used as context.

speakerNames.description: Names of the speakers expected on the call.

idleTimeoutSec.description: Seconds without speech before the vendor closes the session (vendor default 60).

requestId.description: Correlation id sent with the request.

vadThreshold.description: Vendor VAD speech probability threshold (vendor default 0.7).

minSilenceMs.description: Milliseconds of silence that end an utterance (vendor default 500).

minSpeechMs.description: Milliseconds of speech needed to start an utterance.

minSegmentMs.description: Minimum segment length in milliseconds (vendor default 120).

maxSpeechS.description: Maximum utterance length in seconds before it is cut (vendor default disabled).
